summary: Creates a temporary "Special Event Zone" in parts of downtown Nashville from 6:00 a.m. on June 3, 2026, to midnight on June 8, 2026, for the 2026 CMA Fest. Within the zone, it limits street vending, alcohol sales, unlicensed CMA Fest merchandise, tents and temporary structures, free giveaways, vehicles, shared mobility devices, firearms, knives, fireworks and drones unless approved by CMA or Metro, and it requires at least one Public Participation Area for public expression.
